messages.content: Help me execute a performance test in Java with 500 iterations, outputting the results to a `System.out` stream, and using command-line arguments that specify a wait time of 2 minutes?

It also handles synchronization and status checks before, during, and after the thread execution. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

argv.description: An array of command-line arguments to configure the test, including wait time and number of iterations.
